create_transport_base_config: create a TransportBase config with heat conductivity bounds and electron diffusivity limits
build_runtime_params: build runtime parameters from a TransportBase config at a given time step
validate_rho_constraints: validate that rho_outer is greater than rho_inner and rho_max is greater than rho_min for all time
build_transport_model: build a TransportModel instance from a TransportBase subclass configuration
configure_inner_outer_patches: configure inner and outer core transport patches with diffusivity and convection coefficients
